title: When MLK Came to Santa Monica: The Lloyd C. Allen Story
description:
Today, we honor Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. Let us remember and honor his legacy of hope, service and unity.

Hear this inspiring story from 104-year-old Santa Monica legend, Mr. Lloyd C Allen on how he was able to bring MLK to Santa Monica in the 1960's. Mr. Allen started his journey in Santa Monica in 1939 and was one of Santa Monica’s first Black entrepreneurs who served as an essential part of the community.
